message: legacy.adjust.v1 is owned by orders and shipping; a command has exactly one owner (ADR-007).
No service of the workspace owns billing.invoice.v1.
orders doesn't route payments.void.v1 to its owner payments; add routing.Command<…>().To("payments").
orders never receives payments.voided.v1 (step 'void'): it is not a domain event of orders and no service publishes it.
